title: $\texttt{Flip-Team}$: Cooperative Takeover Games with Stochastic Human Override
summary: Shared autonomy requires principled mechanisms for allocating and transferring control between a human and an autonomous agent. Existing approaches often rely on blending control inputs or heuristic switching rules, which lack theoretical guarantees and fail to account for the dynamics of authority transfer. This paper develops a cooperative game-theoretic framework for authority switching in shared autonomy. We formulate the control switching problem as an identical-interest dynamic game in which authority transitions are embedded into the system dynamics, yielding optimal switching…
